Title: Storage auto-grow for Azure Database for MariaDB now generally available

Body.Content:
We’re excited to announce that Azure Database for MariaDB users can opt-in to storage auto-grow, which is now generally available.

With auto-grow enabled, Azure Database for MariaDB will automatically increase the size of the provisioned storage of users’ database servers. As a result, there’s no longer a need to worry about rightsizing when beginning to use these services or about running out of storage.

Learn more in the related Azure Database for MariaDB documentation.
